headline: Exploring Sandy Hook, Connecticut This Autumn
subhead: A closer look at local trails, waterfront parks, and historic village charm.
caption: October brings crisp air and vibrant foliage to Sandy Hook, Connecticut. Nestled along the Pootatuck River, this historic village in Newtown features a walkable center with independent shops and riverside dining. Outdoor opportunities abound, from boating and scenic views at Lake Zoar and Eichler's Cove to hiking trails in Rocky Glen State Park and upper Paugussett State Forest. For travel and commuting, Interstate 84 runs directly through the area, providing straightforward connections across Fairfield County and beyond. Whether you are exploring the trails this fall or curious about available properties in the neighborhood, there is plenty to appreciate across the landscape. Reach out today to discuss your next move in the Greater Danbury area.
